classification: conditional simulation design; not a forecast; percentiles are not calibrated probabilities

unitMap.company_liquidity: USD bn levels; group pressure is a unitless ratio to opening group liquidity
unitMap.china_consumption: index, 2026=100; index points converted by a coefficient to demand fraction
unitMap.eu_claims: USD bn (reported BIS summary) converted to demand fraction by a coefficient
unitMap.eu_materials: tonnes per year; EU ledger only, never converted into demand
unitMap.swiss: CHF per EUR/USD; percent growth; GDP index 2026=100; pp converted by a coefficient
unitMap.global_demand: fraction deviation of normalized demand index, 2026=100

scopeNote: four regions (US, China, EU27, Switzerland); nine conditional scenarios
note: unittest counts only; custom assertion receipts are in accounting.json
